attchmntText: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Investor Presentation of the Company for Q2/H1 of FY 2026-27'.
voiceSummary: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited filed an updated investor presentation for the second quarter and half of the financial year 2026-27 with the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange on November 08, 2026. The company reported an order book valued at INR 7,671 Mn as of September 30, 2026. It highlighted a three-year profit after tax compound annual growth rate of 54 percent and a debt to equity ratio of 0.27. The firm operates 47 drill rigs and has completed over 33 lakh meters of drilling. It currently manages 20 ongoing projects across India and Oman. Key clients include Reliance, Vedanta, Oil India, and Hindustan Copper Ltd. The presentation detailed operations in coal, ferrous, non-ferrous, and oil and gas sectors.

attchmntText: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 08, 2026, titled "Sustained Revenue Growth, Record Order Book and Strategic Expansion Position the Company for a Stronger H2 Robust H1 Revenue Growth Despite Temporary Operational Challenges".
voiceSummary: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited announced financial results for H1 ended 30th Sep 2026. Revenue from operations grew 16% year on year to Rs. 1194 million. Profit after tax increased 23% year on year to Rs. 133 million. The order book reached an all-time high of Rs. 7671 million. The company received trading approvals for equity shares allotted upon conversion of preferential warrants. CRISIL upgraded the company rating to BBB plus stable. Exploration for the Jharkhand Coal Block is complete with the geological report approved. The mining plan submission is expected shortly. New drilling rigs are expected in Q3 FY27.

attchmntText: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited submitted a newspaper advertisement to the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange on November 07, 2026. The submission complies with Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The advertisement contains the Unaudited Financial Results, both Standalone and Consolidated, for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The notice was published in The Financial Express English Edition and Jansatta Hindi Edition on November 07, 2026. Vaishali, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter.
